1 دَرِنَ , aor.
دَرَنَ , inf. n. دَرَنٌ; (T, * S, * M, Msb, K; *) and ↓ ادرن ; (T, M, K;) It (a garment, S, M, &c.) was, or became, dirty, or filthy: (S, M, Msb, K:) or was, or became, defiled, polluted, or smeared, with dirt, or filth. (T, K.) And دَرِنَتْ يَدُهُ بِالشَّىْءِ His hand was, or became, defiled, polluted, or smeared, with the thing. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
